description.en: Nalar is a landing page for AI startups, data and analytics SaaS, and developer tools: show a live product dashboard, explain insights, alerts, and workflows, walk through the CLI, compare plans, and collect early access sign-ups.
description.id: Nalar adalah landing page untuk startup AI, SaaS data dan analitik, dan developer tools: tampilkan dasbor produk langsung, jelaskan insight, alert, dan workflow, tunjukkan alur CLI, bandingkan paket, lalu kumpulkan pendaftaran early access.
